title: Veterinary Benefits Attached to the Live Pet Health Guarantee
content:
Two veterinary benefits come with the Live Pet Health Guarantee for some guarantee types: one free wellness exam after purchase, and reimbursement of outside veterinary costs for a covered illness. Their figures per guarantee type are these.

## Free wellness exam

The free exam period is the number of calendar days after purchase within which one free exam is offered; a figure of 0 means the guarantee type offers none.

| Guarantee type | Free exam period (calendar days after purchase) | Free exam available only at a Tailwise Vet Clinic |
|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | 0 (none) | No |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | 0 (none) | No |
| Live Coral Guarantee | 0 (none) | No |
| Small Animal Guarantee | 14 | Yes |
| Bird Guarantee | 14 | Yes |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | 14 | Yes |

## Outside veterinary costs for a covered illness

| Guarantee type | Largest reimbursement (USD) | How it is reimbursed | Itemized invoice needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Freshwater Fish Guarantee | 0.00 | not reimbursed | No |
| Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee | 0.00 | not reimbursed | No |
| Live Coral Guarantee | 0.00 | not reimbursed | No |
| Small Animal Guarantee | 50.00 | to the original payment | Yes |
| Bird Guarantee | 75.00 | to the original payment | Yes |
| Reptile & Amphibian Guarantee | 75.00 | to the original payment | Yes |

## Questions answered by the tables

**Does a Saltwater Fish & Invertebrate Guarantee include a free exam?** No. Its free exam period is 0, so none is offered; the same holds for the Freshwater Fish and Live Coral Guarantees.

**Where can the free exam for a bird be held?** Only at a Tailwise Vet Clinic, within 14 calendar days after purchase.

**How much of an outside vet bill is reimbursed?** At most the largest reimbursement for the type. Hypothetical illustration: a covered illness under a Small Animal Guarantee with an itemized outside invoice of 80.00 USD is reimbursed 50.00 USD, to the original payment; under a Bird Guarantee the same invoice is reimbursed 75.00 USD; an invoice of 40.00 USD under either type is reimbursed in full, being under the largest reimbursement.

**Is an invoice needed?** For the Small Animal, Bird and Reptile & Amphibian Guarantees an itemized invoice is needed for reimbursement. The aquatic guarantee types do not reimburse outside veterinary costs.
